history.prompt: Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm look, wide establishing composition. A glowing, active physical hardware bypass relay wired directly onto a heavy, dark logic board inside an empty, dimly lit server control room. Single strong practical amber worklight casting long shadows over the brushed metal and intricate circuit probes, contrasting with the deep blue ambient light of the quiet facility. Deep atmospheric haze, restrained teal-and-amber palette, motion implied by glowing fiber optic bundles. Sophisticated editorial photography, generous negative space.

style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: A minimalist studio composition of a modular server rack assembly with a heavy interlocking inspection gate and rack rails. Asymmetric off-centre composition with generous editorial negative space on the left. The engineered parts are arranged in a deliberate locked configuration on a weathered brushed steel surface. Hard clean edges, matte muted dark grey and silver palette. One directional light casting a long, crisp shadow across the steel. Technical, tactile, unlabelled.
negative_prompt: text, lettering, numbers, wordmarks, watermarks, signage, UI, logos, brands, faces, hands
rationale: The component assembly treatment effectively visualizes the shift from abstract policy to a concrete 'control plane' by depicting a physical enforcement mechanism in a server environment.
subject: a modular server rack assembly with an interlocking inspection gate
alt_text: A modular server rack assembly with an interlocking inspection gate resting on brushed steel.
caption: Enterprise leaders are moving AI agent rules from static paper into live runtime enforcement layers.
title: Agent Control Plane Assembly
